title: The Image of God and the Responsibility of Man
author: Samuel Watterson
summary: Examining the Westminster Shorter Catechism's opening question in the light of Scripture, this article traces how God's purpose in creating man — to glorify Him and enjoy Him forever — is grounded in the creation of man in God's image and likeness. The author explores the implications of the image of God for the responsibility of all men, redeemed and unredeemed alike.
